title: The Sandwell and West Birmingham Hospitals National Health Service Trust (Establishment) and the City Hospital National Health Service Trust and Sandwell Healthcare National Health Service Trust (Dissolution) (Amendment) Order 2026
summary: This Order amends the Sandwell and West Birmingham Hospitals National Health Service Trust (Establishment) and the City Hospital National Health Service Trust and Sandwell Healthcare National Health Service Trust (Dissolution) Order 2002 which established the Sandwell and West Birmingham Hospitals National Health Service Trust (“the trust”).

title: The Proceeds of Crime Act 2002 (References to Financial Investigators) (England and Wales and Northern Ireland) (Amendment) Order 2026
summary: This Order amends Schedule 1 to the Proceeds of Crime Act 2002 (References to Financial Investigators) (England and Wales and Northern Ireland) Order 2021 (S.I. 2021/640) (“the 2021 Order”). The Proceeds of Crime Act 2002 (c. 29) (“the 2002 Act”) provides that accredited financial investigators may, in specified circumstances, discharge powers or other functions which are granted to law enforcement officers (such as, for example, police constables or Serious Fraud Office officers).

title: The Occupational Pensions (Revaluation) Order 2026
summary: Section 84 of the Pension Schemes Act 1993 (c. 48) requires certain pensions and other benefits under occupational pension schemes to be revalued by the final salary method (which is dealt with in Schedule 3 to that Act). For the purpose of the revaluation of benefits payable to or in respect of persons who attain their scheme’s normal pension age in 2027, and as required by paragraph 2 of Schedule 3 to that Act, this Order specifies the necessary revaluation percentages for each of the revaluation periods between 1st January 1986 and 31st December 2026. It is not necessary to specify a lower revaluation percentage for revaluation periods which start before 1st January 2009.

title: The Pension Schemes Act 2026 (Commencement No. 2 and Transitional Provisions) Regulations 2026
summary: Part 2 of these Regulations brings sections 109 to 111 of the Pension Schemes Act 2026 (c. 22) (“the 2026 Act”) into force on 31st December 2026, except in the circumstances set out, and for all purposes on 31st December 2027.

title: The Civil and Criminal Legal Aid (Remuneration) and Prohibition of Cross-Examination in Person (Fees of Court-Appointed Qualified Legal Representatives) (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Civil Legal Aid (Remuneration) Regulations 2013 (S.I. 2013/422), the Criminal Legal Aid (Remuneration) Regulations 2013 (S.I. 2013/435) and the Prohibition of Cross-Examination in Person (Fees of Court-Appointed Qualified Legal Representatives) Regulations 2022 (S.I. 2022/567) to amend provisions relating to the claimable standard mileage rate when using a private vehicle for business purposes. It also amends the Civil Legal Aid (Remuneration) Regulations 2013 to ensure that services in relation to respect orders introduced by the Crime and Policing Act 2026 (c. 20) are paid the same fees and at the same rates as those payable in relation to anti-social behaviour injunctions.

title: The Greater London Authority (Consolidated Council Tax Requirement Procedure) Regulations 2026
summary: In relation to each financial year, the Greater London Authority (“the Authority”) is required to make the calculations required by section 85 of the Greater London Authority Act 1999 (“the 1999 Act”), including the calculation of its consolidated council tax requirement.

title: The Pension Protection Fund (Pension Compensation) (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: Regulations 2 and 4 of these Regulations make amendments consequential on section 109 of the Pension Schemes Act 2026 (c. 22), which amends the Pensions Act 2004 (c. 35) and the Pensions Act 2008 (c. 30) to enable periodic compensation payments by the Pension Protection Fund (“PPF”) based on pre-1997 service to be increased. Regulation 3 of these Regulations also makes a separate minor and technical amendment. Regulation 5 does not amend existing legislation but is a provision which will enable the PPF to calculate annual increases on compensation where the pre-1997 service in respect of which compensation is payable relates to a guaranteed minimum pension only.

title: The Water Supply and Sewerage Services (Customer Service Standards) (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Water Supply and Sewerage Services (Customer Service Standards) Regulations 2008 (S.I. 2008/594).

title: The Libya (Sanctions) (EU Exit) (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations are made under the Sanctions and Anti-Money Laundering Act 2018 (c. 13) to amend the Libya (Sanctions) (EU Exit) Regulations 2020 (S.I. 2020/1665) (“the Libya Regulations”).

title: The Voter Identification (Amendment of List of Specified Documents) (Northern Ireland) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations make a change to the list of the types of photographic identification that can be used by a person wishing to vote in person at a polling station at UK Parliamentary elections in Northern Ireland. The changes to the UK Parliamentary election rules also apply to elections to the Northern Ireland Assembly by virtue of article 3 of, and Schedule 1 to, the Northern Ireland Assembly (Elections) Order 2001 (S.I. 2001/2599).

title: The Air Navigation (Restriction of Flying) (Stonehenge) (No. 2) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations impose restrictions on the flying of aircraft in the vicinity of Stonehenge, Wiltshire during the winter solstice period where there will be a large gathering of persons. The Secretary of State for Transport has decided that flying should be restricted in that area for reasons of public safety and security.

title: The Air Navigation (Restriction of Flying) (Springholm, Dumfries and Galloway) (Emergency) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations impose restrictions of an emergency nature on flying in the area specified in the Schedule. They are intended to be of temporary duration and will be revoked as soon as the emergency in question has passed.

title: The Care Planning, Placement and Case Review (England) (Amendment and Transitional Provision) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Care Planning, Placement and Case Review (England) Regulations 2010 (“the 2010 Regulations”), which make provision about care planning for children who are looked after by local authorities. The amendments are made as a result of the commencement of the amendment to section 34 of the Children Act 1989 (c. 41) (“the 1989 Act”) made by section 10 of the Children’s Wellbeing and Schools Act 2026 (c. 21).

title: The Renters’ Rights Act 2025 (Commencement No. 4) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations are the fourth commencement regulations made under the Renters’ Rights Act 2025 (c. 26) (“the 2025 Act”) and bring into force provisions governing the Private Rented Sector Database contained in Chapters 3 and 4 of Part 2 of that Act.

title: The Crime and Policing Act 2026 (Commencement No. 5) (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Crime and Policing Act 2026 (Commencement No. 5) Regulations 2026 (S.I. 2026/1158) (“the No. 5 Regulations”).

title: The Air Navigation (Restriction of Flying) (Portmoak, Perth and Kinross) (Emergency) (Revocation) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations revoke the statutory instrument which imposed emergency restrictions on flying in the area specified in the Schedule to that instrument, the emergency in question having passed.

title: The Air Traffic Management and Unmanned Aircraft (Specified Information etc.) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations specify, for the purposes of paragraph 5 of Schedule 9 to the Air Traffic Management and Unmanned Aircraft Act 2021, the information that a police officer may require from a person suspected of flying an unmanned aircraft.

title: The Cambourne to Cambridge Order 2026
summary: This Order authorises Cambridgeshire County Council to construct and operate a new guided busway system between Sterling Way in Cambourne and Grange Road in Cambridge and carry out all associated works.

title: The State Pension Debits and Credits (Revaluation) Order 2026
summary: This Order is made following a review under section 148AD(1) of the Social Security Administration Act 1992 (c. 5) (revaluation of new state pension debits and credits).

title: The State Pension Revaluation for Transitional Pensions Order 2026
summary: This Order is made following a review under section 148AC(1) of the Social Security Administration Act 1992 (c. 5) (“the Administration Act”) (revaluation for transitional pensions under the Pensions Act 2014 (c. 19)).
